title: MI-MIDI 2: From Observation to Control with Sparse Autoencoders in Text-to-MIDI Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.32007v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) can expose features of a generative model without predefined labels, but in language models the evidence used to interpret these features has proven an unreliable guide to which of them steer the output. Whether interpretations of SAE features predict control in music generators has not, to our knowledge, been tested. We develop an end-to-end protocol for discovering and evaluating SAE features in text-to-MIDI generation and apply it to text2midi and MIDI-LLM. The protocol characterizes features through correlations with musical metrics, shared instrument programs, and automated descriptions, each with its own control: note-density adjustment, matched inactive excerpts, and permutation calibration. It then tests candidates by intervention, measured directly in the generated MIDI against unmodified generation and a matched random direction, ranks them in screens, and confirms selected features on new prompts.

translated_title: MI-MIDI 2：在文本到MIDI生成中利用稀疏自编码器实现从观测到控制
translated_abstract: 稀疏自编码器（SAE）能够在无需预定义标签的情况下揭示生成模型的内部特征，但在语言模型中，用于解释这些特征的证据已被证明对于判断哪些特征能够引导模型输出并不可靠。据我们所知，SAE特征的解释能否预测其在音乐生成器中的控制效果，尚未经过检验。我们开发了一个端到端的协议，用于在文本到MIDI生成中发现和评估SAE特征，并将其应用于text2midi和MIDI-LLM两个模型。该协议通过特征与音乐指标、共享乐器音色程序以及自动生成描述之间的相关性来刻画特征，每种刻画方式均有各自的对照方法：音符密度调整、匹配的非激活片段以及置换校准。随后，协议通过干预实验测试候选特征，直接在生成的MIDI中与未修改的生成结果及匹配的随机方向进行对比测量，在筛选环节中对候选特征进行排序，并在新提示上对选定的特征进行确认。
tldr: 本文提出了一个端到端协议，首次在文本到MIDI生成中系统验证了SAE特征解释对实际输出控制的预测能力，实现了从观测模型特征到干预控制生成结果的跨越。
